letter:
My dearest Liza, my jaan, my forever cutie,  
Every sunrise in Dubai and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful chaos with you. 23 Feb feels like a secret code that unlocks my heart each day. Your laughter echoes across continents, turning deserts into gardens and streets into love songs. I cherish our midnight calls, our shared chai, and the way your smile lights up my world—no matter where we are. Thank you for being my compass, my home, my endless adventure.
poem:
Across the dunes or by the Ganges' flow,  
Your love is the compass that guides me home.  
In every sunset, in each whispered sigh,  
Together we soar, you and I.
